description.value:
Duration constant

It stopped being a pool some time ago. It is just what you are made of now.

Your daily Vitae maximum increases by 4. Once per encounter you may spend Vitae you do not have, up to 4 points: you take 4d6 damage that cannot be prevented or reduced, and the debt is cleared.

cinderfall.incomplete: "+4 daily Vitae maximum" would need a second SpecialResource rule element sharing the vitae slug with a higher max -- whether same-slug SpecialResource elements combine additively or the last one wins is unconfirmed from the schema alone, so this is not shipped as REAL. "Spend Vitae you don't have, take unpreventable damage, debt cleared" is a debt/negative-balance mechanism SpecialResource's schema doesn't have.
